_comment: Example NAV overrides file for portfolio reconstruction. Copy to private_data/nav_overrides.private.json and fill in real NAV values. DO NOT commit with real data.
_format: Keys are fund_code (six-digit string). Values are date→NAV maps. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. NAV is the fund's unit net value on that date.
_usage: Used by reconstruct_portfolio_from_ledger.py to estimate units from cashflow-only transaction history. Only trade-date NAVs are needed — the pipeline does not require a full NAV series.
